{{Top|leg}}
A '''micronnium''' (plural '''micronnia''') was a unit of [[Time/Legends|time]],<ref name="swcw">''[[SkyeWalkers: A Clone Wars Story]]''</ref> composed of one million [[Standard year/Legends|years]], or one thousand [[Millennium/Legends|millennia]].<ref name="Endnotes">{{Blogspot|subdomain=abelgpena|url=2015/06/skyewalkers-clone-wars-story.html|name=The Philodoxer|text=SkyeWalkers: A Clone Wars Story Footnotes/Endnotes, Part 2—Sith Conspiracy Theories? I'm All Shooked Up}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The neologism "micronnium" was created by [[Abel G. Peña]] for his novella ''[[SkyeWalkers: A Clone Wars Story]]''. Peña found that the existing astronomical term "megaannus" was too ungraceful, and he followed the [[Wikipedia:International System of Units|International System of Units]] prefix conventions to coin a new term.<ref name="Endnotes" /> However, the prefix micro- actually denotes a factor of 10^-6 (one millionth). The proper prefix denoting a factor of 10^6 (one million) is mega-.<ref name="SI prefixes">{{WebCite|url=https://www.bipm.org/en/measurement-units|text=Measurement units: the SI|archivedate=20200901232349}}</ref>
